rule: deny by default: a plugin gets only what its manifest requests AND the settings interface granted (plugins scope, capabilities.<capability>); enabling a plugin and every grant take pairing's rights

capabilities.means: a hook or decision provider sees ids, model, sizes, counts, timings, the class and tool names; never a prompt or an answer
as meta, plus the content after the conductor's redaction
prompts and answers as they are
the plugin may connect to this host (a DNS name or an IPv4 address); nothing else beyond the sandbox
capabilities.confirm: when the host is outside the LAN

capabilities.means: the plugin may read the settings interface's non-secret values
the plugin may call engine control (restart, mode) through the controller
the secret NAME (declared in the manifest's secrets) is passed to the plugin's process

never: a plugin never reads the config database, another plugin's secrets, pairing keys or backend keys, whatever it requests
hook_payload: a contributed hook's payload level needs a requested prompts: capability at that level or above

trust.sandboxed: the default: a container or pod of the chat sandbox's class, the egress filter allowing only the granted network: hosts
trust.host: a process of the app's user, outside any sandbox: only once the admin granted it (the plugins scope's trust key, pairing's rights and a second confirm)
trust.engine: a wheel inside the engine: refused, not available yet

enforced: at each use by the plugin host (SRV-859): prompts: levels on hook payloads and provider input, secrets: in the environment and on tandem/secret, settings:read on tandem/settings and the panel bridge, network: by the egress filter; engine:control refused until engine control exists; a refusal is journaled
